LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 嗨，芳草，好久沒見。這瓶葡萄酒送妳。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 嗨，芳草，好久没见。这瓶葡萄酒送你。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Hāi, Fāngcǎo, hǎojiǔ méi jiàn. Zhè píng pútáojiǔ sòng nǐ.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Hi, Fangcao, long time no see. This bottle of wine is for you.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 快進來！人來就好了，別這麼客氣。請坐，請坐。妳知道佳琳生了一對雙胞胎吧？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 快进来！人来就好了，别这么客气。请坐，请坐。你知道佳琳生了一对双胞胎吧？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Kuài jìnlái! Rén lái jiù hǎo le, bié zhème kèqi. Qǐng zuò, qǐng zuò. Nǐ zhīdào Jiālín shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi ba?
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Come in quickly! Just you coming is enough, don't be so polite. Please sit down, please sit down. You know Jialin had a pair of twins, right?

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 上星期就知道了。我一聽到這個好消息，就立刻打電話恭喜她了，她說孩子又乖又可愛，可是很擔心一下子要養兩個會很辛苦。等小孩滿月那天，我們一起去看她吧。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 上星期就知道了。我一听到这个好消息，就立刻打电话恭喜她了，她说孩子又乖又可爱，可是很担心一下子要养两个会很辛苦。等小孩满月那天，我们一起去看她吧。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī jiù zhīdào le. Wǒ yì tīngdào zhè ge hǎo xiāoxi, jiù lìkè dǎ diànhuà gōngxǐ tā le, tā shuō háizi yòu guāi yòu kě'ài, kěshì hěn dānxīn yíxiàzi yào yǎng liǎng ge huì hěn xīnkǔ. Děng xiǎohái mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn tā ba.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: I found out last week. As soon as I heard the good news, I immediately called to congratulate her. She said the babies are both well-behaved and cute, but she's worried that raising two all at once will be very tough. When the babies reach their full month, let's go visit her together.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 好啊。我也想看看那對雙胞胎，也許能抱抱他們。妳想送什麼禮物祝福他們？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 好啊。我也想看看那对双胞胎，也许能抱抱他们。你想送什么礼物祝福他们？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ yě xiǎng kànkan nà duì shuāngbāotāi, yěxǔ néng bàobao tāmen. Nǐ xiǎng sòng shénme lǐwù zhùfú tāmen?
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Sure. I also want to see that pair of twins, and maybe get to hold them. What gift do you want to give to bless them?

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我前兩天到百貨公司選了兩件衣服。（拿出手機）妳看，就是這兩件。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我前两天到百货公司选了两件衣服。（拿出手机）你看，就是这两件。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ qián liǎng tiān dào bǎihuò gōngsī xuǎn le liǎng jiàn yīfu. (Ná chū shǒujī) Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Two days ago I went to the department store and picked out two pieces of clothing. (Takes out cell phone) Look, it's these two.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 好可愛的衣服啊！我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包，可是不知道滿月的紅包要包多少。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 好可爱的衣服啊！我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包，可是不知道满月的红包要包多少。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a! Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo, kěshì bù zhīdào mǎnyuè de hóngbāo yào bāo duōshǎo.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: What cute clothes! As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope, but I don't know how much to put in for a full-month red envelope.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 送紅包這個主意不錯。包多少，要看妳們的關係怎麼樣。不過錢的數字一定得是雙數，而且不可以有「四」喔！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 送红包这个主意不错。包多少，要看你们的关系怎么样。不过钱的数字一定得是双数，而且不可以有「四」喔！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Sòng hóngbāo zhè ge zhǔyì búcuò. Bāo duōshǎo, yào kàn nǐmen de guānxi zěnmeyàng. Búguò qián de shùzì yídìng děi shì shuāngshù, érqiě bù kěyǐ yǒu "sì" o!
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Giving a red envelope is a good idea. How much to give depends on your relationship. But the amount must be an even number, and definitely cannot contain "four"!

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 好，我會注意的。記得去年妳婆婆過生日，妳送給她一盒梨子。妳怕她一個人吃不了整個梨，很體貼地分了一半給她，沒想到她笑了出來。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 好，我会注意的。记得去年你婆婆过生日，你送给她一盒梨子。你怕她一个人吃不了整个梨，很体贴地分了一半给她，没想到她笑了出来。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì zhùyì de. Jìde qùnián nǐ pópo guò shēngrì, nǐ sòng gěi tā yì hé lízi. Nǐ pà tā yí ge rén chī buliǎo zhěng ge lí, hěn tǐtiē de fēn le yíbàn gěi tā, méi xiǎngdào tā xiào le chūlai.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Okay, I will pay attention to that. Remember last year for your mother-in-law's birthday, you gave her a box of pears. You were afraid she couldn't eat an entire pear by herself, so you thoughtfully shared half with her, not expecting her to burst out laughing.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊，當我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思時，就馬上向她道歉。婆婆笑著說，她還不想跟我說再見呢！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊，当我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思时，就马上向她道歉。婆婆笑着说，她还不想跟我说再见呢！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a, dāng wǒ zhīdào bǎ lí fēn yíbàn, yǒu bù hǎo de yìsi shí, jiù mǎshàng xiàng tā dàoqiàn. Pópo xiào zhe shuō, tā hái bù xiǎng gēn wǒ shuō zàijiàn ne!
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Yes, when I found out that dividing a pear has an inauspicious meaning, I immediately apologized to her. Mother-in-law laughed and said she didn't want to say goodbye to me yet!

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 剛來臺灣的時候，我也常因為不清楚文化差異而說錯話、送錯禮。要是那時候能先跟臺灣朋友打聽一下，也許就可以避免這樣的情況了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 刚来台湾的时候，我也常因为不清楚文化差异而说错话、送错礼。要是那时候能先跟台湾朋友打听一下，也许就可以避免这样的情况了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yě cháng yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ wénhuà chāyì ér shuō cuò huà, sòng cuò lǐ. Yàoshi nà shíhou néng xiān gēn Táiwān péngyou dǎting yíxià, yěxǔ jiù kěyǐ bìmiǎn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng le.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: When I first arrived in Taiwan, I also often said the wrong thing or gave the wrong gift because I wasn't clear about cultural differences. If I could have asked around with Taiwanese friends first back then, maybe I could have avoided that kind of situation.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 沒錯。還好我婆婆常教我臺灣的送禮文化，也會給我介紹臺灣的風俗，現在我終於比較了解了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 没错。还好我婆婆常教我台湾的送礼文化，也会给我介绍台湾的风俗，现在我终于比较了解了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Méi cuò. Háihǎo wǒ pópo cháng jiāo wǒ Táiwān de sònglǐ wénhuà, yě huì gěi wǒ jièshào Táiwān de fēngsú, xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Exactly. Fortunately, my mother-in-law often teaches me Taiwan's gift-giving culture and introduces Taiwanese customs to me, so now I finally understand it better.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 其實不僅東西方的文化差異大，連同樣是亞洲國家的越南，飲食習慣也跟臺灣不同。比如，有的臺灣菜醬油放得太多，鹹了點兒。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 其实不仅东西方的文化差异大，连同样是亚洲国家的越南，饮食习惯也跟台湾不同。比如，有的台湾菜酱油放得太多，咸了点儿。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Qíshí bùjǐn dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì dà, lián tóngyàng shì Yàzhōu guójiā de Yuènán, yǐnshí xíguàn yě gēn Táiwān bù tóng. Bǐrú, yǒude Táiwāncài jiàngyóu fàng de tài duō, xián le diǎnr.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Actually, not only is the cultural difference between East and West large, but even for Vietnam, also an Asian country, dietary habits are different from Taiwan. For example, some Taiwanese dishes have too much soy sauce, and are a bit too salty.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。從上次去越南旅行回來，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜歡越南的醬料，還有不加醋，加檸檬汁的越南菜。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我也这么觉得。从上次去越南旅行回来，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜欢越南的酱料，还有不加醋，加柠檬汁的越南菜。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Cóng shàng cì qù Yuènán lǚxíng huílái, wǒ jiù cháng chī Yuènáncài. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Yuènán de jiàngliào, hái yǒu bù jiā cù, jiā níngméngzhī de Yuènáncài.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: I feel the same way. Since returning from traveling to Vietnam last time, I often eat Vietnamese food. I really like Vietnamese sauces, and Vietnamese dishes made with lemon juice instead of vinegar.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 快六點了，等一下我請妳去附近的越南餐廳吃飯吧！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 快六点了，等一下我请你去附近的越南餐厅吃饭吧！
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Kuài liù diǎn le, děng yíxià wǒ qǐng nǐ qù fùjìn de Yuènán cāntīng chī fàn ba!
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: It's almost six o'clock; in a little while let me treat you to dinner at a nearby Vietnamese restaurant!

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 這些菜樣樣都好吃，特別是紅豆點心，可惜我吃不下了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 这些菜样样都好吃，特别是红豆点心，可惜我吃不下了。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yàngyàng dōu hǎochī, tèbié shì hóngdòu diǎnxin, kěxī wǒ chī bu xià le.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: Every single one of these dishes is delicious, especially the red bean dessert; pity I can't eat any more.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 剩下的菜妳要不要打包？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 剩下的菜你要不要打包？
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shèngxià de cài nǐ yào bu yào dǎbāo?
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Do you want to pack up the leftover food?

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 不用了。在美國打包剩菜是很常見的，只是我沒這個習慣，從不打包。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 不用了。在美国打包剩菜是很常见的，只是我没这个习惯，从不打包。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Bú yòng le. Zài Měiguó dǎbāo shèngcài shì hěn chángjiàn de, zhǐshì wǒ méi zhè ge xíguàn, cóng bù dǎbāo.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary: No need. In America, packing up leftovers is very common, it's just that I don't have this habit and never pack them up.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Then let's just forget it.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 佳琳
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 親愛的以晴：收到妳的卡片，知道妳要結婚的消息，真叫我高興。看了你們兩人的相片，穿上洋裝的妳好漂亮，妳先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一對。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 亲爱的以晴：收到你的卡片，知道你要结婚的消息，真叫我高兴。看了你们两人的相片，穿上洋装的你好漂亮，你先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一对。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Qīn'ài de Yǐqíng: Shōudào nǐ de kǎpiàn, zhīdào nǐ yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi, zhēn jiào wǒ gāoxìng. Kàn le nǐmen liǎng rén de xiàngpiàn, chuān shàng yángzhuāng de nǐ hǎo piàoliang, nǐ xiānsheng yòu gāodà yòu yīngjùn, zhēn shì xìngfú de yí duì.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Dear Yiqing: Receiving your card and knowing the news of your upcoming marriage made me truly happy. Looking at the photo of the two of you, you look so beautiful in a dress, and your husband is so tall and handsome; you are truly a blessed couple.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 佳琳
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 記得我在美國留學時，我們常一塊兒吃喝玩樂，也常一同閱讀、討論，思考未來的方向。開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。戀愛了五年的男友離開我時，妳陪著我哭，三大盒面紙都被我們抽光了。對我來說，那些珍貴的回憶是一輩子都忘不了的。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 记得我在美国留学时，我们常一块儿吃喝玩乐，也常一同阅读、讨论，思考未来的方向。开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。恋爱了五年的男友离开我时，你陪着我哭，三大盒面纸都被我们抽光了。对我来说，那些珍贵的回忆是一辈子都忘不了的。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Jìde wǒ zài Měiguó liúxué shí, wǒmen cháng yíkuàir chī hē wán lè, yě cháng yìtóng yuèdú, tǎolùn, sīkǎo wèilái de fāngxiàng. Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bùtíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bùtíng. Liàn'ài le wǔ nián de nányǒu líkāi wǒ shí, nǐ péi zhe wǒ kū, sān dà hé miànzhǐ dōu bèi wǒmen chōu guāng le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, nàxiē zhēnguì de huíyì shì yíbèizi dōu wàng buliǎo de.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: I remember when I was studying abroad in the US, we often ate, drank, and had fun together, and also read, discussed, and pondered the future together. When happy, we laughed non-stop; when sad, we cried non-stop. When my boyfriend of five years left me, you cried with me, and we went through three large boxes of tissues. To me, those precious memories can never be forgotten in a lifetime.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 佳琳
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 我非常想去美國參加妳的婚禮，可是這段時間我還在坐月子。「坐月子」是華人的傳統習慣，照我婆婆的說法，女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天；還應該注意營養，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗頭，這樣才能早點兒恢復健康。我外婆也說，這個時候身體最要緊，孩子滿月以前，我們母子都不能出門。所以我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事。我非常感謝她、尊敬她，也一定會孝順她的。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 我非常想去美国参加你的婚礼，可是这段时间我还在坐月子。「坐月子」是华人的传统习惯，照我婆婆的说法，女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天；还应该注意营养，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗头，这样才能早点儿恢复健康。我外婆也说，这个时候身体最要紧，孩子满月以前，我们母子都不能出门。所以我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事。我非常感谢她、尊敬她，也一定会孝顺她的。
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xiǎng qù Měiguó cānjiā nǐ de hūnlǐ, kěshì zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hái zài zuòyuèzi. "Zuòyuèzi" shì Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, zhào wǒ pópo de shuōfǎ, nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān; hái yīnggāi zhùyì yíngyǎng, búdàn bù néng xǐ lěngshuǐzǎo, érqiě bù néng xǐ tóu, zhèyàng cái néng zǎodiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng. Wǒ wàipó yě shuō, zhè ge shíhou shēntǐ zuì yàojǐn, háizi mǎnyuè yǐqián, wǒmen mǔzǐ dōu bù néng chūmén. Suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi; pópo měitiān búshì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì. Wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, zūnjìng tā, yě yídìng huì xiàoshùn tā de.
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: I would love to go to America to attend your wedding, but during this time I'm still doing postpartum confinement. "Sitting the month" is a traditional Chinese custom; according to my mother-in-law, after a woman gives birth she must rest for a month, no more and no less, exactly thirty days; she also needs to pay attention to nutrition, and not only cannot take cold showers, but also cannot wash her hair, so that she can recover her health sooner. My maternal grandmother also said that at this time one's health is the most critical; before the child reaches a full month, mother and baby cannot go outdoors. Therefore, every day besides eating and sleeping, I'm just holding the baby and nursing him; every day my mother-in-law either makes fish soup or chicken soup for me to drink, or helps me buy groceries and do housework. I am so grateful to her, respect her, and will definitely be filial to her.

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 佳琳
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional:
在臺灣，孩子滿月那天，我們會送油飯和紅蛋給親人、朋友，感謝大家對孩子的祝福。可惜妳在美國，沒辦法請妳吃。等我們見面的時候，再好好地一起吃個飯、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生貴子
好友 佳琳
9.28
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified:
在台湾，孩子满月那天，我们会送油饭和红蛋给亲人、朋友，感谢大家对孩子的祝福。可惜你在美国，没办法请你吃。等我们见面的时候，再好好地一起吃个饭、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生贵子
好友 佳琳
9.28
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin:
Zài Táiwān, háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen huì sòng yóufàn hàn hóngdàn gěi qīnrén, péngyou, gǎnxiè dàjiā duì háizi de zhùfú. Kěxī nǐ zài Měiguó, méi bànfǎ qǐng nǐ chī. Děng wǒmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, zài hǎohāode yìqǐ chī ge fàn, liáo yì liáo. Zhù
Píng'ān jiànkāng, shìshì rúyì, zǎoshēng guìzǐ
Hǎoyǒu Jiālín
9.28
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.english:
In Taiwan, on the baby's one-month day, we send glutinous oil rice and red eggs to relatives and friends to thank everyone for their blessings to the baby. Unfortunately you are in America, so there is no way to treat you. When we meet, let's have a nice meal together and have a good chat. Wishing you:
Peace and health, everything according to your wishes, and early birth of precious children,
Your good friend Jialin,
Sept 28

dialogue.title: 對話 · 孩子滿月了 · One Month Old

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 嗨，芳草，好久沒見。這瓶葡萄酒送妳。
lines.simplified: 嗨，芳草，好久没见。这瓶葡萄酒送你。
lines.pinyin: Hāi, Fāngcǎo, hǎojiǔ méi jiàn. Zhè píng pútáojiǔ sòng nǐ.
lines.english: Mary: Hi, Fangcao, long time no see. This bottle of wine is for you.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快進來！人來就好了，別這麼客氣。請坐，請坐。妳知道佳琳生了一對雙胞胎吧？
lines.simplified: 快进来！人来就好了，别这么客气。请坐，请坐。你知道佳琳生了一对双胞胎吧？
lines.pinyin: Kuài jìnlái! Rén lái jiù hǎo le, bié zhème kèqi. Qǐng zuò, qǐng zuò. Nǐ zhīdào Jiālín shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: Come in quickly! Just you coming is enough, don't be so polite. Please sit down, please sit down. You know Jialin had a pair of twins, right?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 上星期就知道了。我一聽到這個好消息，就立刻打電話恭喜她了，她說孩子又乖又可愛，可是很擔心一下子要養兩個會很辛苦。等小孩滿月那天，我們一起去看她吧。
lines.simplified: 上星期就知道了。我一听到这个好消息，就立刻打电话恭喜她了，她说孩子又乖又可爱，可是很担心一下子要养两个会很辛苦。等小孩满月那天，我们一起去看她吧。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī jiù zhīdào le. Wǒ yì tīngdào zhè ge hǎo xiāoxi, jiù lìkè dǎ diànhuà gōngxǐ tā le, tā shuō háizi yòu guāi yòu kě'ài, kěshì hěn dānxīn yíxiàzi yào yǎng liǎng ge huì hěn xīnkǔ. Děng xiǎohái mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn tā ba.
lines.english: Mary: I found out last week. As soon as I heard the good news, I immediately called to congratulate her. She said the babies are both well-behaved and cute, but she's worried that raising two all at once will be very tough. When the babies reach their full month, let's go visit her together.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好啊。我也想看看那對雙胞胎，也許能抱抱他們。妳想送什麼禮物祝福他們？
lines.simplified: 好啊。我也想看看那对双胞胎，也许能抱抱他们。你想送什么礼物祝福他们？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ yě xiǎng kànkan nà duì shuāngbāotāi, yěxǔ néng bàobao tāmen. Nǐ xiǎng sòng shénme lǐwù zhùfú tāmen?
lines.english: Fangcao: Sure. I also want to see that pair of twins, and maybe get to hold them. What gift do you want to give to bless them?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我前兩天到百貨公司選了兩件衣服。（拿出手機）妳看，就是這兩件。
lines.simplified: 我前两天到百货公司选了两件衣服。（拿出手机）你看，就是这两件。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qián liǎng tiān dào bǎihuò gōngsī xuǎn le liǎng jiàn yīfu. (Ná chū shǒujī) Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
lines.english: Mary: Two days ago I went to the department store and picked out two pieces of clothing. (Takes out cell phone) Look, it's these two.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好可愛的衣服啊！我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包，可是不知道滿月的紅包要包多少。
lines.simplified: 好可爱的衣服啊！我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包，可是不知道满月的红包要包多少。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a! Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo, kěshì bù zhīdào mǎnyuè de hóngbāo yào bāo duōshǎo.
lines.english: Fangcao: What cute clothes! As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope, but I don't know how much to put in for a full-month red envelope.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 送紅包這個主意不錯。包多少，要看妳們的關係怎麼樣。不過錢的數字一定得是雙數，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.simplified: 送红包这个主意不错。包多少，要看你们的关系怎么样。不过钱的数字一定得是双数，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.pinyin: Sòng hóngbāo zhè ge zhǔyì búcuò. Bāo duōshǎo, yào kàn nǐmen de guānxi zěnmeyàng. Búguò qián de shùzì yídìng děi shì shuāngshù, érqiě bù kěyǐ yǒu "sì" o!
lines.english: Mary: Giving a red envelope is a good idea. How much to give depends on your relationship. But the amount must be an even number, and definitely cannot contain "four"!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好，我會注意的。記得去年妳婆婆過生日，妳送給她一盒梨子。妳怕她一個人吃不了整個梨，很體貼地分了一半給她，沒想到她笑了出來。
lines.simplified: 好，我会注意的。记得去年你婆婆过生日，你送给她一盒梨子。你怕她一个人吃不了整个梨，很体贴地分了一半给她，没想到她笑了出来。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì zhùyì de. Jìde qùnián nǐ pópo guò shēngrì, nǐ sòng gěi tā yì hé lízi. Nǐ pà tā yí ge rén chī buliǎo zhěng ge lí, hěn tǐtiē de fēn le yíbàn gěi tā, méi xiǎngdào tā xiào le chūlai.
lines.english: Fangcao: Okay, I will pay attention to that. Remember last year for your mother-in-law's birthday, you gave her a box of pears. You were afraid she couldn't eat an entire pear by herself, so you thoughtfully shared half with her, not expecting her to burst out laughing.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 是啊，當我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思時，就馬上向她道歉。婆婆笑著說，她還不想跟我說再見呢！
lines.simplified: 是啊，当我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思时，就马上向她道歉。婆婆笑着说，她还不想跟我说再见呢！
lines.pinyin: Shì a, dāng wǒ zhīdào bǎ lí fēn yíbàn, yǒu bù hǎo de yìsi shí, jiù mǎshàng xiàng tā dàoqiàn. Pópo xiào zhe shuō, tā hái bù xiǎng gēn wǒ shuō zàijiàn ne!
lines.english: Mary: Yes, when I found out that dividing a pear has an inauspicious meaning, I immediately apologized to her. Mother-in-law laughed and said she didn't want to say goodbye to me yet!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剛來臺灣的時候，我也常因為不清楚文化差異而說錯話、送錯禮。要是那時候能先跟臺灣朋友打聽一下，也許就可以避免這樣的情況了。
lines.simplified: 刚来台湾的时候，我也常因为不清楚文化差异而说错话、送错礼。要是那时候能先跟台湾朋友打听一下，也许就可以避免这样的情况了。
lines.pinyin: Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yě cháng yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ wénhuà chāyì ér shuō cuò huà, sòng cuò lǐ. Yàoshi nà shíhou néng xiān gēn Táiwān péngyou dǎting yíxià, yěxǔ jiù kěyǐ bìmiǎn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: When I first arrived in Taiwan, I also often said the wrong thing or gave the wrong gift because I wasn't clear about cultural differences. If I could have asked around with Taiwanese friends first back then, maybe I could have avoided that kind of situation.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 沒錯。還好我婆婆常教我臺灣的送禮文化，也會給我介紹臺灣的風俗，現在我終於比較了解了。
lines.simplified: 没错。还好我婆婆常教我台湾的送礼文化，也会给我介绍台湾的风俗，现在我终于比较了解了。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Háihǎo wǒ pópo cháng jiāo wǒ Táiwān de sònglǐ wénhuà, yě huì gěi wǒ jièshào Táiwān de fēngsú, xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
lines.english: Mary: Exactly. Fortunately, my mother-in-law often teaches me Taiwan's gift-giving culture and introduces Taiwanese customs to me, so now I finally understand it better.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 其實不僅東西方的文化差異大，連同樣是亞洲國家的越南，飲食習慣也跟臺灣不同。比如，有的臺灣菜醬油放得太多，鹹了點兒。
lines.simplified: 其实不仅东西方的文化差异大，连同样是亚洲国家的越南，饮食习惯也跟台湾不同。比如，有的台湾菜酱油放得太多，咸了点儿。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí bùjǐn dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì dà, lián tóngyàng shì Yàzhōu guójiā de Yuènán, yǐnshí xíguàn yě gēn Táiwān bù tóng. Bǐrú, yǒude Táiwāncài jiàngyóu fàng de tài duō, xián le diǎnr.
lines.english: Fangcao: Actually, not only is the cultural difference between East and West large, but even for Vietnam, also an Asian country, dietary habits are different from Taiwan. For example, some Taiwanese dishes have too much soy sauce, and are a bit too salty.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。從上次去越南旅行回來，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜歡越南的醬料，還有不加醋，加檸檬汁的越南菜。
lines.simplified: 我也这么觉得。从上次去越南旅行回来，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜欢越南的酱料，还有不加醋，加柠檬汁的越南菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Cóng shàng cì qù Yuènán lǚxíng huílái, wǒ jiù cháng chī Yuènáncài. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Yuènán de jiàngliào, hái yǒu bù jiā cù, jiā níngméngzhī de Yuènáncài.
lines.english: Mary: I feel the same way. Since returning from traveling to Vietnam last time, I often eat Vietnamese food. I really like Vietnamese sauces, and Vietnamese dishes made with lemon juice instead of vinegar.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快六點了，等一下我請妳去附近的越南餐廳吃飯吧！
lines.simplified: 快六点了，等一下我请你去附近的越南餐厅吃饭吧！
lines.pinyin: Kuài liù diǎn le, děng yíxià wǒ qǐng nǐ qù fùjìn de Yuènán cāntīng chī fàn ba!
lines.english: Fangcao: It's almost six o'clock; in a little while let me treat you to dinner at a nearby Vietnamese restaurant!

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 這些菜樣樣都好吃，特別是紅豆點心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.simplified: 这些菜样样都好吃，特别是红豆点心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yàngyàng dōu hǎochī, tèbié shì hóngdòu diǎnxin, kěxī wǒ chī bu xià le.
lines.english: Mary: Every single one of these dishes is delicious, especially the red bean dessert; pity I can't eat any more.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剩下的菜妳要不要打包？
lines.simplified: 剩下的菜你要不要打包？
lines.pinyin: Shèngxià de cài nǐ yào bu yào dǎbāo?
lines.english: Fangcao: Do you want to pack up the leftover food?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 不用了。在美國打包剩菜是很常見的，只是我沒這個習慣，從不打包。
lines.simplified: 不用了。在美国打包剩菜是很常见的，只是我没这个习惯，从不打包。
lines.pinyin: Bú yòng le. Zài Měiguó dǎbāo shèngcài shì hěn chángjiàn de, zhǐshì wǒ méi zhè ge xíguàn, cóng bù dǎbāo.
lines.english: Mary: No need. In America, packing up leftovers is very common, it's just that I don't have this habit and never pack them up.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 那就算了吧。
lines.simplified: 那就算了吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù suàn le ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Then let's just forget it.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express spontaneous exclamation or admiration about a noun using 好 + Vs + 的 + N + (啊)!
grammarPages.explanation: 「好 Vs 的 N（啊）！」是說話的人想表達強烈感嘆語氣時使用的。例如：「好有趣的表演啊！」、「好苦的咖啡！難怪你不喝。」

text.traditional:
瑪莉：……妳看，就是這兩件。
芳草：好可愛的衣服啊！
text.simplified:
玛莉：……你看，就是这两件。
芳草：好可爱的衣服啊！
text.pinyin:
Mǎlì: …Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
Fāngcǎo: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
text.english: Mary: …Look, these are the two. Fangcao: What cute clothes!

text.traditional:
A：好酸的檸檬汁啊！你忘了加糖嗎？
B：我以為你要喝無糖的，所以沒加。
text.simplified:
A：好酸的柠檬汁啊！你忘了加糖吗？
B：我以为你要喝无糖的，所以没加。
text.pinyin:
A: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a! Nǐ wàng le jiā táng ma?
B: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ yào hē wú táng de, suǒyǐ méi jiā.
text.english: A: What sour lemon juice! Did you forget to add sugar? B: I thought you wanted it without sugar, so I did not add any.

text.traditional:
A：我早上出門時忘了帶手機，沒想到兒子親自拿到公司給我。
B：好體貼的兒子！我女兒跟你兒子年紀差不多，就沒那麼關心我。
text.simplified:
A：我早上出门时忘了带手机，没想到儿子亲自拿到公司给我。
B：好体贴的儿子！我女儿跟你儿子年纪差不多，就没那么关心我。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ zǎoshang chūmén shí wàng le dài shǒujī, méi xiǎngdào érzi qīnzì ná dào gōngsī gěi wǒ.
B: Hǎo tǐtiē de érzi! Wǒ nǚ'ér gēn nǐ érzi niánjì chàbuduō, jiù méi nàme guānxīn wǒ.
text.english: A: I forgot my phone when I left this morning; unexpectedly, my son brought it to my office himself. B: What a considerate son! My daughter is about his age, but she does not care about me that much.

items.question: Why do we say 好可愛的衣服啊 instead of 很可愛的衣服啊 as an exclamation?
items.answer: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 forms a standalone exclamatory noun phrase. 很 is a neutral degree modifier and cannot form this exclamation.
items.wrongTraditional: 你看，這是很可愛的衣服啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 你看，这是很可爱的衣服啊！

right.traditional: 你看，這是好可愛的衣服啊！
right.simplified: 你看，这是好可爱的衣服啊！
right.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
right.english: Look, what cute clothes this is!

items.question: Can we omit 的 in 好Vs的N(啊)?
items.answer: No, 的 is required to connect the stative verb to the noun in this exclamatory pattern.

questions.correctFeedback: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 expresses an exclamation admiring the clothing.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 to make an exclamatory phrase.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 好 Vs 的 N（啊）! is used when the speaker wants to express a strong feeling. For example, 好有趣的表演啊！Or 好苦的咖啡！難怪你不喝。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express deliberating repeatedly or taking repeated actions before still reaching a conclusion using V來V去，還是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「V 來 V 去，還是……」表示說話的人不斷重複某一個動作，花了時間，最後還是沒什麼改變。「還是」的後面表示說話人的看法、感想或決定。例如：我逛來逛去，還是覺得夜市的東西最便宜。

text.traditional: 我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包……
text.simplified: 我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包……
text.pinyin: Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo…
text.english: As for me, after thinking it over, I still decided to give a red envelope…

text.traditional: 這幾個月我不斷地找工作，或許是我的眼光太高，找來找去，還是找不到合適的。
text.simplified: 这几个月我不断地找工作，或许是我的眼光太高，找来找去，还是找不到合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè wǒ búduàn de zhǎo gōngzuò, huòxǔ shì wǒ de yǎnguāng tài gāo, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bu dào héshì de.
text.english: I have been looking for work these past few months; perhaps my standards are too high. After all that searching, I still cannot find anything suitable.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，還是覺得這個社區的環境最好，不僅綠樹多、空氣新鮮，交通也方便。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，还是觉得这个社区的环境最好，不仅绿树多、空气新鲜，交通也方便。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juéde zhè ge shèqū de huánjìng zuì hǎo, bùjǐn lǜ shù duō, kōngqì xīnxiān, jiāotōng yě fāngbiàn.
text.english: After looking around, I still think this community has the best environment: lots of green trees, fresh air, and convenient transportation.

items.question: Why do we say 想來想去，還是…… instead of just 想想，還是……?
items.answer: V來V去 emphasizes repeated, prolonged deliberation before concluding, whereas 想想 is just a brief thought.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想想，還是決定送紅包。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想想，还是决定送红包。

right.traditional: 我想來想去，還是決定送紅包。
right.simplified: 我想来想去，还是决定送红包。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo.
right.english: After thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope.

items.question: What function does 還是 have after V來V去?
items.answer: 還是 indicates that despite the repeated actions or spent time, the speaker returns to an original or steadfast choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 我看來看去，所以買這件衣服。
items.wrongSimplified: 我看来看去，所以买这件衣服。

right.traditional: 我看來看去，還是買這件衣服。
right.simplified: 我看来看去，还是买这件衣服。
right.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì mǎi zhè jiàn yīfu.
right.english: After looking back and forth, I still bought this piece of clothing.

questions.correctFeedback: 選來選去，還是 expresses choosing back and forth before still opting for Vietnamese cuisine.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V來V去，還是…… to express deliberation leading back to a choice.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: "V 來 V 去，還是……" means that the speaker repeatedly carries out a certain action. After having spent/wasted time, nothing has changed. The statement after 還是 shows the speaker's views, feelings or decisions. For example, 我逛來逛去，還是覺得夜市的東西最便宜。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express reaching a hoped-for, expected, or anticipated result after a long process with 終於.
grammarPages.explanation: 「終於」是副詞。表示經過一個很長的過程，最後好不容易達到希望、期待或預期的結果。「終於」的前面是主語，後面可以接動詞或不及物狀態動詞（Vs）。句尾加「了」表示狀態的變化。

text.traditional: ……現在我終於比較了解了。
text.simplified: ……现在我终于比较了解了。
text.pinyin: …Xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
text.english: …Now I finally understand better.

text.traditional: 我家附近上個星期終於有一家設備新、空間大的健身房了。
text.simplified: 我家附近上个星期终于有一家设备新、空间大的健身房了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn shàng ge xīngqī zhōngyú yǒu yì jiā shèbèi xīn, kōngjiān dà de jiànshēnfáng le.
text.english: Last week, a gym with new equipment and a large space finally opened near my home.

text.traditional: 媽媽到了機場才發現護照不見了，找來找去，終於在她的口袋裡找到了，真糊塗啊！
text.simplified: 妈妈到了机场才发现护照不见了，找来找去，终于在她的口袋里找到了，真糊涂啊！
text.pinyin: Māma dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn hùzhào bú jiàn le, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zài tā de kǒudài lǐ zhǎodào le, zhēn hútu a!
text.english: Mom only noticed her passport was missing when she reached the airport. After searching everywhere, she finally found it in her pocket. How forgetful!

items.question: When do you use 終於 instead of 最後?
items.answer: 終於 carries strong emotional relief after an arduous effort or long wait. 最後 is simply the chronological final event.
items.wrongTraditional: 準備了一整年，最後考上大學了！
items.wrongSimplified: 准备了一整年，最后考上大学了！

right.traditional: 準備了一整年，終於考上大學了！
right.simplified: 准备了一整年，终于考上大学了！
right.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi le yì zhěng nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng dàxué le!
right.english: After preparing for a whole year, I finally got into college!

items.question: Where is 終於 placed in a sentence?
items.answer: 終於 is an adverb placed after the subject and before the verb phrase.

questions.correctFeedback: 終於 indicates that after months of effort, he finally succeeded.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 終於 to mark an achievement after prolonged effort.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 終於 is an adverb. It means that after a long process, it is finally possible to achieve the hope, expectation or desired result. Put the subject in front of 終於, followed by a verb or intransitive state verb (Vs). 了 is put at the end to indicate a change in state.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 坐月子 · Confinement After Childbirth

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 親愛的以晴：收到妳的卡片，知道妳要結婚的消息，真叫我高興。看了你們兩人的相片，穿上洋裝的妳好漂亮，妳先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一對。
lines.simplified: 亲爱的以晴：收到你的卡片，知道你要结婚的消息，真叫我高兴。看了你们两人的相片，穿上洋装的你好漂亮，你先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一对。
lines.pinyin: Qīn'ài de Yǐqíng: Shōudào nǐ de kǎpiàn, zhīdào nǐ yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi, zhēn jiào wǒ gāoxìng. Kàn le nǐmen liǎng rén de xiàngpiàn, chuān shàng yángzhuāng de nǐ hǎo piàoliang, nǐ xiānsheng yòu gāodà yòu yīngjùn, zhēn shì xìngfú de yí duì.
lines.english: Dear Yiqing: Receiving your card and knowing the news of your upcoming marriage made me truly happy. Looking at the photo of the two of you, you look so beautiful in a dress, and your husband is so tall and handsome; you are truly a blessed couple.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 記得我在美國留學時，我們常一塊兒吃喝玩樂，也常一同閱讀、討論，思考未來的方向。開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。戀愛了五年的男友離開我時，妳陪著我哭，三大盒面紙都被我們抽光了。對我來說，那些珍貴的回憶是一輩子都忘不了的。
lines.simplified: 记得我在美国留学时，我们常一块儿吃喝玩乐，也常一同阅读、讨论，思考未来的方向。开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。恋爱了五年的男友离开我时，你陪着我哭，三大盒面纸都被我们抽光了。对我来说，那些珍贵的回忆是一辈子都忘不了的。
lines.pinyin: Jìde wǒ zài Měiguó liúxué shí, wǒmen cháng yíkuàir chī hē wán lè, yě cháng yìtóng yuèdú, tǎolùn, sīkǎo wèilái de fāngxiàng. Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bùtíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bùtíng. Liàn'ài le wǔ nián de nányǒu líkāi wǒ shí, nǐ péi zhe wǒ kū, sān dà hé miànzhǐ dōu bèi wǒmen chōu guāng le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, nàxiē zhēnguì de huíyì shì yíbèizi dōu wàng buliǎo de.
lines.english: I remember when I was studying abroad in the US, we often ate, drank, and had fun together, and also read, discussed, and pondered the future together. When happy, we laughed non-stop; when sad, we cried non-stop. When my boyfriend of five years left me, you cried with me, and we went through three large boxes of tissues. To me, those precious memories can never be forgotten in a lifetime.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 我非常想去美國參加妳的婚禮，可是這段時間我還在坐月子。「坐月子」是華人的傳統習慣，照我婆婆的說法，女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天；還應該注意營養，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗頭，這樣才能早點兒恢復健康。我外婆也說，這個時候身體最要緊，孩子滿月以前，我們母子都不能出門。所以我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事。我非常感謝她、尊敬她，也一定會孝順她的。
lines.simplified: 我非常想去美国参加你的婚礼，可是这段时间我还在坐月子。「坐月子」是华人的传统习惯，照我婆婆的说法，女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天；还应该注意营养，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗头，这样才能早点儿恢复健康。我外婆也说，这个时候身体最要紧，孩子满月以前，我们母子都不能出门。所以我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事。我非常感谢她、尊敬她，也一定会孝顺她的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xiǎng qù Měiguó cānjiā nǐ de hūnlǐ, kěshì zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hái zài zuòyuèzi. "Zuòyuèzi" shì Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, zhào wǒ pópo de shuōfǎ, nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān; hái yīnggāi zhùyì yíngyǎng, búdàn bù néng xǐ lěngshuǐzǎo, érqiě bù néng xǐ tóu, zhèyàng cái néng zǎodiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng. Wǒ wàipó yě shuō, zhè ge shíhou shēntǐ zuì yàojǐn, háizi mǎnyuè yǐqián, wǒmen mǔzǐ dōu bù néng chūmén. Suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi; pópo měitiān búshì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì. Wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, zūnjìng tā, yě yídìng huì xiàoshùn tā de.
lines.english: I would love to go to America to attend your wedding, but during this time I'm still doing postpartum confinement. "Sitting the month" is a traditional Chinese custom; according to my mother-in-law, after a woman gives birth she must rest for a month, no more and no less, exactly thirty days; she also needs to pay attention to nutrition, and not only cannot take cold showers, but also cannot wash her hair, so that she can recover her health sooner. My maternal grandmother also said that at this time one's health is the most critical; before the child reaches a full month, mother and baby cannot go outdoors. Therefore, every day besides eating and sleeping, I'm just holding the baby and nursing him; every day my mother-in-law either makes fish soup or chicken soup for me to drink, or helps me buy groceries and do housework. I am so grateful to her, respect her, and will definitely be filial to her.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional:
在臺灣，孩子滿月那天，我們會送油飯和紅蛋給親人、朋友，感謝大家對孩子的祝福。可惜妳在美國，沒辦法請妳吃。等我們見面的時候，再好好地一起吃個飯、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生貴子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.simplified:
在台湾，孩子满月那天，我们会送油饭和红蛋给亲人、朋友，感谢大家对孩子的祝福。可惜你在美国，没办法请你吃。等我们见面的时候，再好好地一起吃个饭、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生贵子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.pinyin:
Zài Táiwān, háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen huì sòng yóufàn hàn hóngdàn gěi qīnrén, péngyou, gǎnxiè dàjiā duì háizi de zhùfú. Kěxī nǐ zài Měiguó, méi bànfǎ qǐng nǐ chī. Děng wǒmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, zài hǎohāode yìqǐ chī ge fàn, liáo yì liáo. Zhù
Píng'ān jiànkāng, shìshì rúyì, zǎoshēng guìzǐ
Hǎoyǒu Jiālín
9.28
lines.english:
In Taiwan, on the baby's one-month day, we send glutinous oil rice and red eggs to relatives and friends to thank everyone for their blessings to the baby. Unfortunately you are in America, so there is no way to treat you. When we meet, let's have a nice meal together and have a good chat. Wishing you:
Peace and health, everything according to your wishes, and early birth of precious children,
Your good friend Jialin,
Sept 28

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action that goes on continuously without stopping or ending using V + 個不停 / 個沒完.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V 個不停」強調同樣的動作在短時間內不斷地重複，例如：這幾天雨下個不停。而「V 個沒完」強調做某動作時，不想或是沒辦法停止，例如：昨天剛考完試，今天又考了，每天考試考個沒完。「V 個沒完」一般用在說話的人對這樣的情況覺得不好或感到不耐煩。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 個不停 / 個沒完

text.traditional: 開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。
text.simplified: 开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。
text.pinyin: Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bù tíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bù tíng.
text.english: When happy, they laugh nonstop; when sad, they cry nonstop.

text.traditional: 最近工作很多，我們每天開會開個不停，電話也接個不停，累死了。
text.simplified: 最近工作很多，我们每天开会开个不停，电话也接个不停，累死了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒmen měi tiān kāihuì kāi ge bù tíng, diànhuà yě jiē ge bù tíng, lèi sǐ le.
text.english: There has been a lot of work lately; every day we have endless meetings and phone calls. We are exhausted.

text.traditional: 我的雙胞胎兒子整天吵個沒完、哭個沒完，真不知道怎麼辦才好。
text.simplified: 我的双胞胎儿子整天吵个没完、哭个没完，真不知道怎么办才好。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shuāngbāotāi érzi zhěngtiān chǎo ge méi wán, kū ge méi wán, zhēn bù zhīdào zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
text.english: My twin sons fuss and cry all day without end. I really do not know what to do.

items.question: How is V個不停 different from 一直V?
items.answer: 一直V simply marks duration or persistence, whereas V個不停 conveys vivid, ceaseless action with an exasperated or emotional tone.
items.wrongTraditional: 他上課的時候，總是一直說話了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他上课的时候，总是一直说话了。

right.traditional: 他上課的時候，總是說個不停。
right.simplified: 他上课的时候，总是说个不停。
right.pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhou, zǒngshì shuō ge bùtíng.
right.english: During class, he is always talking non-stop.

items.question: When a verb has an object (like 開會), where does 個不停 go?
items.answer: The verb is repeated: 開會開個不停 or 接電話接個不停.

right.traditional: 我們每天開會開個不停。
right.simplified: 我们每天开会开个不停。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān kāihuì kāi ge bùtíng.
right.english: We hold meetings non-stop every day.

questions.correctFeedback: 問個不停 shows his habit of asking ceaseless questions until he understands.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V + 個不停 to convey non-stop activity.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V 個不停 emphasizes that the same action is repeated continuously in a short period of time. For example, 這幾天雨下個不停。V 個沒完 emphasizes that a certain action takes place without stopping. For example, 昨天剛考完試，今天又考了，每天考試考個沒完。V 個沒完 is usually used when the person speaking feels bad about or impatient with such a situation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a moderate, suitable, or just-right condition using paired opposite stative verbs in 不Vs1不Vs2.
grammarPages.explanation: 「不 Vs₁ 不 Vs₂」說明介於「Vs₁」和「Vs₂」兩者之間的程度，表示說話的人覺得適中、適宜、舒服的，數量或程度正好。例如：不大不小、不多不少、不高不矮、不新不舊等。兩個 Vs 都必須是單音詞，而且意思相反，如：大小、多少、高矮、新舊、遠近、快慢、好壞、冷熱等。

text.traditional: 女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.simplified: 女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.pinyin: Nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān.
text.english: After giving birth, women must rest for one month: exactly thirty days.

text.traditional: 這種不冷不熱的天氣舒服極了，不但適合野餐、露營，還很適合爬山。
text.simplified: 这种不冷不热的天气舒服极了，不但适合野餐、露营，还很适合爬山。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bù lěng bú rè de tiānqì shūfu jí le, búdàn shìhé yěcān, lùyíng, hái hěn shìhé páshān.
text.english: This weather is neither cold nor hot and is extremely comfortable. It suits picnics, camping, and hiking.

text.traditional: 林老師說話的速度不快不慢，例子的說明也很清楚，學生很容易就明白了。
text.simplified: 林老师说话的速度不快不慢，例子的说明也很清楚，学生很容易就明白了。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shuōhuà de sùdù bú kuài bú màn, lìzi de shuōmíng yě hěn qīngchǔ, xuésheng hěn róngyì jiù míngbai le.
text.english: Teacher Lin speaks neither fast nor slowly and explains examples clearly, so students understand easily.

items.question: Why are the paired antonyms fixed in order (e.g. 不大不小, not 不小不大)?
items.answer: Conventional pairing always places the primary/positive dimension first: 大小, 多少, 高矮, 新舊, 遠近, 快慢, 好壞, 冷熱.
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服不小不大，穿起來剛好。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服不小不大，穿起来刚好。

right.traditional: 這件衣服不大不小，穿起來剛好。
right.simplified: 这件衣服不大不小，穿起来刚好。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú dà bù xiǎo, chuān qǐlai gānghǎo.
right.english: This piece of clothing is neither big nor small; it fits just right.

items.question: Can two unrelated stative verbs be used in this pattern?
items.answer: No, the two Vs must be direct monosyllabic antonyms signifying two opposing ends of a single continuum.
items.wrongTraditional: 這個西瓜不甜不貴，很好吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个西瓜不甜不贵，很好吃。

right.traditional: 這個西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.simplified: 这个西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.pinyin: Zhè ge xīguā bú dà bù xiǎo, hěn hǎo ná.
right.english: This watermelon is neither big nor small, very easy to carry.

questions.correctFeedback: 不高不矮 describes a moderate height.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不高不矮 for human height.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: "不 Vs₁ 不 Vs₂" illustrates the degree between "Vs₁" and "Vs₂", indicating that the person speaking feels the situation is moderate, appropriate, and suitable, and the number or degree is just right. Both Vs must be monosyllabic with opposite meanings. The order is 大小, 多少, 高矮, 新舊, 遠近, 快慢, 好壞, 冷熱, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an exclusive situation where, aside from one thing, only one other possibility or activity exists with 除了……(以外)，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 這個語法強調如果「除了」後面的人事物排除，就只有「就是」後面的人事物。「以外」可以省略。例如：「我來臺灣除了學中文以外，就是工作」、「他週末除了爬山，就是在家打掃」。
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + NP1 / VP1 + (以外)，就是 + NP2 / VP2

text.traditional: ……我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶……
text.simplified: ……我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶……
text.pinyin: …Wǒ měi tiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi…
text.english: …Every day, apart from eating and sleeping, I just hold the baby and feed him milk…

text.traditional: 小李在咖啡館打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他覺得很輕鬆。
text.simplified: 小李在咖啡馆打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他觉得很轻松。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zài kāfēiguǎn dǎgōng, měi tiān chúle zhǔ kāfēi yǐwài, jiùshì cā zhuōzi, dào lèsè, tā juéde hěn qīngsōng.
text.english: Xiao Li works at a cafe. Every day, apart from making coffee, he just wipes tables and takes out the garbage; he finds it easy.

text.traditional: 我家冰箱裡的東西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水餃和雞蛋。
text.simplified: 我家冰箱里的东西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水饺和鸡蛋。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā bīngxiāng lǐ de dōngxi bù duō, chúle píjiǔ, jiùshì yìxiē shuǐjiǎo hé jīdàn.
text.english: There is not much in my fridge: apart from beer, just some dumplings and eggs.

items.question: How does 除了……就是…… differ from 除了……也/還……?
items.answer: 除了……就是…… is exclusive: excluding X, only Y exists. 除了……還/也…… is additive: in addition to X, Y also applies.
items.wrongTraditional: 我週末除了睡覺以外，也工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 我周末除了睡觉以外，也工作。

right.traditional: 我週末除了睡覺以外，就是工作。
right.simplified: 我周末除了睡觉以外，就是工作。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò chúle shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì gōngzuò.
right.english: On weekends, besides sleeping, I just work (nothing else).

items.question: Can 以外 be omitted in 除了……就是……?
items.answer: Yes, 以外 can be omitted without changing the meaning.
items.wrongTraditional: 除了中文，我就是只學英文。
items.wrongSimplified: 除了中文，我就是只学英文。

right.traditional: 除了中文，我就是學英文。
right.simplified: 除了中文，我就是学英文。
right.pinyin: Chúle Zhōngwén, wǒ jiùshì xué Yīngwén.
right.english: Besides Chinese, I just study English.

segments.traditional: 他下班回家後，除了吃飯，
segments.simplified: 他下班回家后，除了吃饭，

questions.correctFeedback: 除了……就是…… indicates that watching TV is the sole remaining activity.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 除了……就是…… to express an exclusive remaining action.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This grammer emphasizes that if the person or thing after 除了 is excluded, there is only the person or thing after 就是. The phrase 以外 can be omitted. For example, 我來臺灣除了學習中文以外，就是工作。Or 他週末除了爬山，就是在家打掃。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an alternative compound where either one condition or the other must happen using 不是……，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「不是……，就是……」為選擇複句，表示「不是」後面的人事物和「就是」後面的人事物，兩個當中一定有一個發生或成立，沒有其他的情況或選擇。例如：教室裡的書包不是小美的，就是小麗的。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不是 + Choice 1，就是 + Choice 2

text.traditional: 婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事……
text.simplified: 婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事……
text.pinyin: Pópo měi tiān bú shì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì…
text.english: Every day my mother-in-law either makes fish or chicken soup for me, or helps me shop for food and do housework…

text.traditional: 小華很會利用放假的時間，不是去健身，就是參加各種社團活動。
text.simplified: 小华很会利用放假的时间，不是去健身，就是参加各种社团活动。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Huá hěn huì lìyòng fàngjià de shíjiān, bú shì qù jiànshēn, jiùshì cānjiā gè zhǒng shètuán huódòng.
text.english: Xiao Hua makes good use of his time off, either working out or joining various club activities.

words.meaning: every kind of; all kinds of; various

text.traditional: 每年華語中心的春節活動，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，今年我們來設計一些不同的活動吧！
text.simplified: 每年华语中心的春节活动，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，今年我们来设计一些不同的活动吧！
text.pinyin: Měi nián Huáyǔ Zhōngxīn de Chūnjié huódòng, bú shì chànggē, jiùshì tiàowǔ, jīnnián wǒmen lái shèjì yìxiē bù tóng de huódòng ba!
text.english: The Chinese center’s Lunar New Year activities are always either singing or dancing. Let us design some different activities this year!

items.question: How does 不是……就是…… differ from 除了……就是……?
items.answer: 不是……就是…… presents two alternative possibilities (either A or B). 除了……就是…… states that after removing A, only B exists.
items.wrongTraditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果以外，就是香蕉。
items.wrongSimplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果以外，就是香蕉。

right.traditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果，就是香蕉。
right.simplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果，就是香蕉。
right.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de shuǐguǒ búshì píngguǒ, jiùshì xiāngjiāo.
right.english: The fruit on the table is either apples or bananas.

items.question: Can 不是……就是…… be used when both options happen simultaneously?
items.answer: No, 不是……就是…… is strictly disjunctive (one or the other). For both, use 不但……而且…… or 又……又…….

right.english: He is either reading books or writing characters.

segments.hint: either older brother or younger brother

questions.correctFeedback: 不是……就是…… indicates that one of the two brothers must have eaten it.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不是……就是…… for two mutually exclusive alternative possibilities.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不是……，就是…… is a compound sentence which means either the person and the thing after 不是 or the person and the thing after 就是 must happen or be established, there are no other conditions or choices. For example, 教室裡的書包不是小美的，就是小麗的。
